description: Returns a payment link for one of the ways to keep the book: voices, which brings the book online with it, or keepsake, which is the printed hardcover. It returns the price for this book in the money of the buyer’s country when the country is given, from the same table as the site: the keepsake’s price depends on the kind of book, and a book over 400 printed pages pays the page charge on every copy when it prints. Stripe’s page takes the card and, on the keepsake, the postal address. This tool never takes a card.

country.description: The buyer’s country as a two-letter code, such as US, GB or DE, so the price comes back in their money.

option.description: voices or keepsake. Only the keepsake is printed and posted. book is taken as voices, which includes the book online.
